in_sanskrit.name: मधविलाता
in_sanskrit.meaning: Beloved of Lord Vishnu (Madhava) and Lata (climbing plant)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Madhava: A name of Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. He is the one who preserves the universe and sustains all life. Lata: A climbing plant, often used as a metaphor for a beautiful and attractive woman. Madhavilata: A name meaning 'beloved of Lord Vishnu and Lata'.
